immutable_operation_causal_anchor_v1.definition: An operation-level, compact, immutable causal-route fact established independently before a later candidate relies on it. It is evidence, not a membership/admission/UI/registry label.
immutable_operation_causal_anchor_v1.identity: sha256(ANCHOR_VERSION, operation_id, route_type, route_semantic_version, ordered role identities, causal direction, source evidence identity, ordering evidence identity)
immutable_operation_causal_anchor_v1.deep_configuration: route_type=SELECTED_UPSTREAM; role_left=pool; role_right=coordinator; causal_direction=POOL_TO_COORDINATOR. No Deep-specific table is created.
immutable_operation_causal_anchor_v1.establishment_rule: Only an independent prospectively qualified route/ordering lifecycle may create it. establishment_source=membership is rejected. The candidate creating an anchor may not use its new anchor as its sole automatic-admit evidence.
immutable_operation_causal_anchor_v1.multiple_anchors: allowed; each immutable identity is retained. Matching is exact; qualified contradictory candidate route is CONFLICT and missing/mismatched anchor is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

prospective_transaction_order_evidence_v.definition: Compact authoritative direction between two already-known signatures. It never uses block time, lexical signatures, or instruction index as a cross-transaction substitute.
prospective_transaction_order_evidence_v.different_slot_rule: parent_slot < child_slot => PARENT_BEFORE_CHILD; parent_slot > child_slot => PARENT_AFTER_CHILD.
prospective_transaction_order_evidence_v.same_slot_rule: Both qualified transaction-array ordinals are required; lower ordinal is earlier. Missing ordinal is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
prospective_transaction_order_evidence_v.fallback: one known-signature getTransaction request, zero retries, only if compact slot is absent; if and only if slots are equal, at most one getBlock for that known slot.

bootstrap.first_anchor_rule: Use a future independently qualified route/ordering lifecycle, committed before any later V2 evaluation. Never create an anchor from membership alone.
bootstrap.reason: The retained historical 26 are membership registrations without independently durable per-member prospective V1 causal witness/anchor facts. No historical labels, global recovery, or synthetic bridge were used.

continuity_contract.input: candidate immutable causal route + immutable_operation_causal_anchor_v1; do not enumerate operator_launch_membership.
continuity_contract.qualified: exact immutable route identity match under the route semantic version
continuity_contract.conflict: only independently qualified contradictory candidate route evidence
continuity_contract.membership_independence: anchor content/identity is unaffected by membership fixture mutation

fixture_results.ordering_restart_reuse: PASS by deterministic unique compact records

implementation.test_command: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_prospective_anchor_order_retention.py tests/test_operation_admission_adapter.py tests/test_known_signature_slot.py tests/test_transaction_order.py tests/test_capital_continuity.py
